fehler.email: An email address looks like this: name@example.org – with @ and an ending such as .com or .org.
fehler.telefon: A phone number contains only digits, + at the start, spaces, /, - and brackets.
fehler.internetseite: A website looks like this: www.example.org or https://www.example.org – without spaces.
fehler.iban.aufbau: An IBAN starts with two letters for the country and two check digits, e.g. DE89 3704 0044 0532 0130 00.
fehler.iban.land: There is no IBAN for the country code “{land}”. Check the first two letters.
fehler.iban.laenge: An IBAN from {land} has {laenge} characters, this one has {ist}. Check whether a character is missing or doubled.
fehler.iban.pruefziffer: The IBAN’s check digits don’t match – probably a typo. Compare it with the original once more.
fehler.plz: A German postcode has exactly 5 digits. For another country, enter it in the “Country” field.
fehler.datum.zukunft: The date must not be in the future.
fehler.datum.vergangenheit: The date must not be in the past.
fehler.datum.vor: The date must not be before {datum}.
fehler.datum.nach: The date must not be after {datum}.
definition.format: A format exists only for text fields: email, phone, website, IBAN or postcode.
definition.landfeld.nurplz: A field for the country exists only with the postcode format.
definition.landfeld.fehlt: The field for the country (“{feld}”) doesn’t exist in this folder type as a text or choice field.
definition.datum.grenze: Earliest and latest: “today” or a date such as 2000-01-01.
editor.format.hilfe: New and changed details must match; on a phone the matching keyboard appears. Saved details stay valid – Workbench → Maintenance shows which don’t match.
editor.landfeld.hilfe: If it says Germany or nothing, the postcode has exactly 5 digits. For other countries it is free.
editor.datum.hilfe: For example “Latest today” for a birthday. Saved details stay valid.
editor.frist.hilfe: The date appears under “To do” and in the calendar and triggers “Date reached”
editor.frist.erinnern: How many days before and whom Ablago reminds, you set in a “Date reached” automation (lead time).
wartung.titel: Details that don’t match the format
wartung.text: If a field gets a format or limits, saved details stay valid. Here you see, for each folder type and field, which ones don’t match. As soon as someone changes the field, the detail must match.
wartung.leer: All saved details match their format and limits.
verweis.mehr: {zahl} in total – type to narrow down.
verweis.unpassend.regel: doesn’t match this field’s selection rule
verweis.unpassend.titel: Stays valid; only what matches the selection can be chosen anew.
eingabe.betrag-negativ: Credit note or refund? Enter it with a minus.
verweis.noch-kein-ziel: The folder types for this field come with another package – none is installed yet.
